{{Top|leg}}
'''Mallif Cove''' was an island on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core planet]] of [[Recopia]], inhabited only by a small village of eccentric monks known simply as the [[Mallif]]. These green-cloaked religious recluses were the descendants of the [[Seyugi Dervish]]es, a fanatical cult of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-using [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] who once menaced the Core systems. At some point, the monks forgot their ancestors and were unaware that in the deepest levels of their fortress, the Seyugi Dervishes lay in hibernation, waiting to be awoken.
